raw.details:
Deadline Extended: PPT submission deadline has been extended to 21st September 2026, 12:00 PM IST. Register now before it closes!

The Department of Information Technology, SGSITS, is organizing HackIndore 4.0, a 24-hour National Hackathon that brings together students from diverse academic backgrounds to design, build, and demonstrate technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges. The event provides participants with an opportunity to apply their technical knowledge, creativity, and problem-solving skills to develop practical solutions within a competitive hackathon environment.

The hackathon is designed as an intensive, hands-on building experience where participants will identify challenges, develop innovative approaches, create functional prototypes, and present their solutions within a limited timeframe. Teams will work on real-world problem statements across multiple technology domains, supported by mentors and evaluated by an expert panel of judges.

Building on the success of HackIndore 3.0, the 4th edition introduces a continuous 24-hour development experience, challenging teams to transform their ideas into working prototypes through collaboration, rapid development, and effective execution under real hackathon conditions.

Event Details:

  • Event Name: HackIndore 4.0
  • Organized by: Department of Information Technology, SGSITS
  • Mode: Offline (Final Round) | Online Screening (Round 1)
  • Venue: Shri G.S. Institute of Technology & Science, Indore
  • Registration Fee: ₹360 per team
  • Hackathon Dates: 27th–28th September 2026

Looking for Teammates?
If you're a solo participant or need more members to complete your team, join our official WhatsApp group to connect with others in the same situation. Go to this link:  TEAM FINDING HACKINDORE 4.0

NOTE: This group is exclusively for finding teammates. Keep the group focused and spam-free.

Purpose of the Event:

The primary objective of HackIndore 4.0 is to provide an intensive platform where students can transform ideas into practical technology solutions. The event will help participants:

  • Strengthen their problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Enhance their technical, creative, and design capabilities
  • Collaborate effectively and develop solutions under tight deadlines
  • Gain hands-on experience in building and demonstrating functional prototypes
  • Develop the ability to present technical solutions clearly and convincingly

Themes:

Participants can explore diverse domains, real-world challenges, and emerging areas of technology across the following themes:

  • Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems: Building AI-powered solutions that can understand, reason, make decisions, and perform tasks with minimal human intervention.
  • Cybersecurity: Developing solutions that protect individuals, organizations, and digital systems from cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and risks.
  • FinTech: Creating technology-driven solutions that address modern financial needs, services, and challenges.
  • Tech for Life: Using technology to address challenges in healthcare, accessibility, safety, wellbeing, and everyday life.
  • Robotics & Physical Computing: Building technologies that interact with the physical world, including robots, electronic systems, and hardware-based solutions.
  • Smart Cities, Mobility & Infrastructure: Developing solutions that improve urban transportation, public infrastructure, essential services, and the way cities function.
  • Everyday India – Daily Social Problems: Solving everyday problems faced by people across India through practical, affordable, and scalable technology.
  • Open Innovation: Exploring solutions to problems and opportunities across diverse domains, with the freedom to innovate beyond the defined themes.

Problem Statements Releasing on 8th September 2026  10:00 PM.

  • Note: Shortlisted teams must develop and demonstrate their prototype on-site during the 24-hour offline hackathon.
  • The core solution must be developed during the hackathon, and pre-built projects cannot be submitted as final solutions.

Eligibility:

  • Open to all students currently enrolled in undergraduate programs, irrespective of discipline.
  • Each participant must carry a valid Identity Proof/Student ID for verification.
  • Registrations are open to inter-college, inter-branch, and inter-university teams.

Event Rounds:

  • Idea Submission (Online Screening): Participants will submit a detailed presentation outlining their understanding of the problem, proposed solution, methodology, innovation, and feasibility.
  • 24-Hour Offline Hackathon: The top 30 shortlisted teams will report to the SGSITS campus and develop a working prototype during 24 continuous hours of intensive building and collaboration.
  • Final Presentation: Teams will present and demonstrate their completed prototype while explaining their approach, implementation, innovation, and potential real-world impact to the judges.

Judging Criteria:

Projects will be evaluated on:

  • Relevance to the problem statement
  • Originality and creativity
  • Technical approach and quality of execution
  • Practicality, feasibility, scalability, and potential impact
  • Quality of presentation and demonstration

Rules

  • All submissions and solutions must be original.
  • The core solution must be developed during the hackathon.
  • Submitting existing projects or substantially pre-built solutions, or copying from other sources, will lead to disqualification.
  • Participants must bring their own laptops and any hardware required for their solution.
  • Participants must comply with all event guidelines and maintain professional and ethical conduct throughout the event.
  • Any changes to the rules, schedule, or event format will be communicated to registered participants.

Prizes & Certificates

With a combined prize pool exceeding ₹1 Lakh, the top teams will be rewarded for their innovation, technical execution, and overall performance:

  • Winner: ₹20,000 cash
  • First Runner-Up: ₹12,000 cash
  • Second Runner-Up: ₹8,000 cash
  • All Finalists: Premium Developer Tools Access (worth ₹50,000+) + Participation Certificate + Stickers
  • All Participants: Participation Certificate

Internship Opportunities: Standout participants across all teams will be considered for internship opportunities by our Tech Sponsor — based on their performance and potential during the hackathon.

Industry Connect: All finalists will get the opportunity to network with industry professionals, mentors and tech leaders present at the event.

Bring your ideas. Build under pressure. Solve real problems.

HackIndore 4.0 — 24 Hours. One Challenge. Limitless Innovation.
